## Summary

Work for #8469 

## Changes proposed

- Added hero section for Award Recommendation Page, containing:
    - Breadcrumbs (currently just link to homepage)
    - Title
    - Date Prepared
    - Status tag (new component)
    - Save/Create buttons (currently non-functional)
- Added mock data fetching for award recommendation
- Moved AR page from `/award-recommendation` to
`/award-recommendation/:id`
- Added unit tests

## Context for reviewers

Note that, as API endpoints have not yet been built, the data contained
in the hero is mock data, and the save/create buttons are
non-functional.

**Wireframe**

https://www.figma.com/design/o5g0d2W5RKHYHjdvVCqTV2/Grantor-Designs-%7C-Quad-5-%7C-Simpler-Grants-2026?node-id=4575-92115&t=giXarKRBpSMfKExd-1

## Validation steps
- [ ] `awardRecommendationOff` set to false
- [ ] navigate to localhost:3000/award-recommendation/some-id
- [ ] Ensure header matches figma designs
- [ ] To test the variants of the status tag, go to
`frontend/src/services/fetch/fetchers/awardRecommendationFetcher.ts` and
change `mockStatus` from "draft" to "in_progress" and "pending_review"

Some refactors to the form generation process for clarity, and removing unused code branches. Does not affect functionality of any existing forms.

When reviewing form generation code for the the expandable field group tech spec (https://navasage.atlassian.net/wiki/x/AgCqgg), I was confused by a few points that I thought could be easily cleaned up.

We may want to support subsections or some other more deeply nested implementation in the future, but it is not necessary now and adds complexity, so taking that out
* adding some comments
* renaming some variables
* more deliberate error handling in getFieldConfig
